call.detail: Earnings call and 2026 Investor and Analyst Day started 08:00 ET this morning and may still be running into the open; content not reviewed in time. The pre-market slid from about +17% (after hours) to +8.7% over the same hours, which is consistent with the call/investor day being read as less than the after-hours price assumed (inference from the tape, not from a transcript).

tape_read.note: Robust reference 268.1 = +8.70% vs prev close 246.65, almost exactly the frozen release read (+9.0) and inside the 11.4% implied move. But prev close (246.65) is 8.7% below the 13:30 entry (270.01), so the long is -0.7% at the pre-market reference. The tape ran up to +16.8% after hours and a 292.49 high, then sagged to 268.0 at 09:15, at the bottom of the pre-market range (low 267.5) during the call/investor day. Active pre-market: 215 prints, 31 in the last 30 minutes, last print 09:15, not stale. Market +0.3-0.4%.

thesis_check.note: The numbers confirm the thesis (beat above guide top, 2027 reset well above the old street), but the market's read of the investor day has taken away half the after-hours gain; the 2027 EPS is close to what the July guide already implied.

expected.open_lag_note: Liquid, active pre-market (31 prints in the last half hour, last at 09:15) on an amc name with a full night, so the open should hold most of the +8.7%; slightly raised lag chance because the pre-market is sliding into the open at its low. Earnings gaps of this size tend to give part back by 10:00, and the momentum from 292 to 268 points the same way.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers en de 2027-vooruitzichten zijn sterk en de koers voor de opening (+8,7%) weerspiegelt dat al ongeveer volledig. De stijging is tijdens de beleggersdag gehalveerd van +17% naar +8,7% en zakt nog; een winstsprong geeft na de opening vaak iets terug. Verkoop bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 weer duidelijk boven 280 dollar klimt (de daling tijdens de beleggersdag keert om), is een limietorder rond 285 te overwegen.
